answer_1.quote: Given a document in the copyrighted corpus C, we use the first 200 tokens as the prompt to the model being evaluated and the next 200 tokens as the ground truth continuation.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates continuations based on prompts derived from copyrighted articles, aiming to avoid verbatim quotes while preserving information and utility.

answer_2.quote: We propose a novel metric to quantify the worst-case infringement risk for a given model M over a large-scale text corpus C: given a set of responses {y i } N i=1 from M , %R > Q(τ ) measures the percentage of the responses that contain any quote of length greater than τ

answer_3.quote: To evaluate the information quality of model generated continuations, we employ a LLM-based evaluation scheme and prompt Llama3.3-70B-Instruct with relevant evaluation instructions to produce a score on a 5-point scale.
